title: Granola AI Pricing (2026): Free Tier, Plans and Limits
summary: Granola AI pricing includes a free tier and paid options for individuals and teams. Understand the cost of each plan to pick the right option for you.
body_markdown:
## Granola against its closest alternatives on price


At $14 per user per month billed monthly, Granola is cheaper than several paid note-takers here, though free tiers cost less.


The table below shows the gap, so you can see how much each alternative adds per person, per month.


Prices come from[Transcribex](https://www.transcribex.io/blog/ai-note-taker-pricing/) and were checked in October 2026.


Tool Paid price per user per month, billed monthly Extra over Granola


Granola $14 none


Otter $16.99 $2.99


Fireflies $18 $4


Read AI $19.75 $5.75


Fathom $20 $6

Ten people on Fathom instead of Granola costs **$60 more a month, or $720 a year** .


On these monthly figures, no alternative is cheaper.


I haven't confirmed free-tier limits, annual discounts or team-plan rates, so I won't claim one wins there. If a free tier covers your meeting volume, it beats $14 by definition. Check each vendor's pricing page before you rule one out.

Granola's Business plan carries no price premium. What matters is whether its features fit how your team works. If they do, the lowest sticker price makes it the default for larger teams, where the per-seat gap grows fastest.


### Funding backdrop and price changes


According to[Tech.eu](https://tech.eu/2026/03/25/granola-raises-125m-at-1-5bn-valuation/) , Granola's valuation went from $21.25 million at seed in 2023 to $102.78 million at Series A in 2024. It reached $250 million at Series B in 2025 and $1,500 million at Series C in 2026.


That's **roughly a 70-fold rise in three years** . A company valued that way is under pressure to grow revenue, so **treat $14 as today's price, not a promise** .
